parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that determines the start position of the query. Set this parameter to the value of the NextToken parameter that is returned from the last call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo-controller list-clusters --next-token a3f2224a5ec7224116c4f5246120abe2 --max-results 20 --resource-group-id rg-aek2bg6wyoox6jq --tags Value=my_value Key=my_key --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eflo-controller ListClusters --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1.Value my_value --NextToken a3f2224a5ec7224116c4f5246120abe2 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek2bg6wyoox6jq' --MaxResults 20 --Tags.1.Key my_key
